response.overview: For various reasons, different couples decide to head to the most famous hotel on the Pan-American Highway. Among those arriving that day are two friends looking to swap partners; a comedian who can’t resist the urge to tell jokes to his companion; a former Nazi with his new partner; a married couple who have never set foot in such a hotel; a stingy client with a prostitute; an impersonator and his devoted fan; and many others. Through an endless succession of gags and hilarious situations, this first major video production unfolds.
response.title: Y...Dónde está el hotel?
